videos.title: 3ABN Today Bible Q&A
videos.description: Many believers wrestle with end-time anxiety, hard-to-understand prophecies, and questions about God’s presence in daily life. In this episode, we explore what Scripture says about coming events, personal prayer, faith versus presumption, and the meaning behind passages such as Psalm 139, Revelation 12, Ezekiel 9, and more. Join us for a grounded, Bible-centered conversation designed to bring peace, clarity, and confidence in God’s leading.

videos.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
videos.description: How can we tell whether someone who claims the gift of prophecy is truly speaking for God? This lesson explores the biblical tests of a genuine prophet, beginning with the counsel of 1 John 4:1 to “test the spirits.” Like a diamond examined for authenticity, prophetic claims must be carefully tested by Scripture. Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.

videos.description: “Behold,” God predicted in Old Testament times, “I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord.” Malachi 4:5. Watch Steve Wohlberg and David Machado join forces to explore mighty biblical truths about the ancient showdown between Elijah and false prophets, John the Baptist, and God’s end-time Elijahs who warn the world about Satan’s global deceptions and Mystery Babylon before the battle of Armageddon.

videos.title: White Horse Media
videos.description: Debates about the Godhead rage on. What does the Bible really say about the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit? Are they three separate, equal, co-eternal Persons united in one, or only two (the Father and the Son), with the Father being the “true God,” and the Holy Spirit being an invisible manifestation of the Son? In this new 5-part series, Steve Wohlberg and Kim Kjaer tackle this issue head on.
